w1_design_correction.prior_assumption_in_route_doc: benzbromarone and TD-3 are both 'rigid' references, contrasted with flexible lesinurad.
w1_design_correction.verified_finding: TD-3 has the SAME rotatable-bond count as lesinurad (5), driven by the same liability: a flexible thioether linker to a terminal carboxylic acid (lesinurad: -S-CH2-COOH; TD-3: -S-C(CH3)2-COOH). Only benzbromarone (3 rotatable bonds, ketone linker, no thioether-carboxylate swivel arm) is a genuinely more rigid reference.

corrected_pass_rule.receptor_prep_sanity_control: benzbromarone self-dock Top-1 RMSD <= 2.0 A. This is the only ligand in the triad that tests 'is the pipeline broken' independent of the flexibility hypothesis.
corrected_pass_rule.TD-3_role_reinterpreted: TD-3 is a same-chemotype flexibility replicate of lesinurad, not a contrasting rigid control. If TD-3 ALSO shows elevated self-dock RMSD, that CORROBORATES (does not contradict) the flexible-thioether-carboxylate-arm explanation for lesinurad's failure, and strengthens the case for geometry-first pose selection (A2) over free Top-1 CNNscore selection (A1) on this class of ligand.
corrected_pass_rule.if_benzbromarone_also_fails: stop_and_audit_receptor_prep, as originally planned -- this outcome is unchanged.
